description: Read-only, aggregate operational state for Honcho workspaces. No message, document, peer, session, or queue payload content is exported.

options.content:
## General information
Workspace health, aggregate memory structure, synchronization, backlog age, and native deriver throughput.

## Honcho operational state

All data is collected by a dedicated, read-only PostgreSQL role through aggregate-only queries. The **Workspace** selector accepts one, many, or All workspaces. Document levels and queue workflows have concrete separate charts: they do not depend on Grafana repeat-template expansion. Each chart retains a distinct workspace-labelled series, so multi-workspace selections are never silently aggregated. **Exporter health** confirms current database access; queue and embedding series show workflow backlog/state, not individual customer or agent activity.

panels.title: Exporter / database health
panels.description: 1 means the latest aggregate-only PostgreSQL snapshot succeeded; 0 means it failed. This is access/collection health, not the state of a specific queue task.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of the latest exporter aggregate snapshot. Sustained increases can indicate database load or an inefficient query plan.

panels.title: Sessions and peers
panels.description: Current aggregate peer count and active/inactive session counts. These are counts only; no names or identifiers are exported.

panels.title: Messages and tokens
panels.description: Stored aggregate message count and aggregate token count. These are retained database totals rather than the current context window or traffic rate.

panels.title: Embedding synchronization state
panels.description: Aggregate document and message embedding rows grouped by bounded sync state. A persistent pending or failed population indicates reconciliation work to investigate.

panels.title: Oldest pending work age
panels.description: Age of the oldest queue item that is pending (unprocessed and not active), grouped by bounded task type. A high value is backlog age, not runtime duration of an active task.

panels.title: Active queue sessions
panels.description: Distinct active queue work-unit count. It should be interpreted with queue state counts; it does not expose any work-unit identifiers.

panels.title: Native deriver queue throughput
panels.description: Rate of queue items completed by the native Honcho deriver process. This is a throughput counter from the loopback-only native metrics endpoint, distinct from the exporter’s point-in-time queue inventory.

panels.title: Native deriver generated-token throughput
panels.description: Generated output tokens per second, grouped by deriver task type. This uses only component=output_total and token_type=output. Unlike the input accounting components, these series can be read as output-token throughput and are not an overlapping breakdown.

panels.title: Native deriver input-token accounting components (not additive)
panels.description: Input-token rates as reported by the native deriver. prompt, messages, and previous_summary are overlapping accounting components for the same work, so do NOT sum them into a total. This panel exposes the breakdown rather than hiding it.

options.content:
## Documents by deletion state
One chart per document level; each chart keeps `deleted=false` and `deleted=true` as distinct series.

panels.title: $workspace explicit documents by deletion state
panels.description: Direct facts stated in the source conversation, stored without interpretation. Series split them into retained (deleted=false) and marked-deleted (deleted=true) documents.

panels.title: $workspace deductive documents by deletion state
panels.description: Conclusions that follow from one or more stored premises. Series split them into retained (deleted=false) and marked-deleted (deleted=true) documents.

panels.title: $workspace inductive documents by deletion state
panels.description: Patterns or generalizations inferred from multiple observations; they include a confidence level. Series split them into retained (deleted=false) and marked-deleted (deleted=true) documents.

panels.title: $workspace contradiction documents by deletion state
panels.description: Records of source observations that conflict with each other; they flag inconsistency rather than choose a winner. Series split them into retained (deleted=false) and marked-deleted (deleted=true) documents.

options.content:
## Queue items by state
One chart per workflow; each chart keeps `pending`, `in_progress`, and `completed` as distinct series.

panels.title: $workspace webhook queue items by state
panels.description: Outbound webhook delivery work after a Honcho event. Series show how many deliveries are pending, in progress, or completed.

panels.title: $workspace summary queue items by state
panels.description: Session-summary maintenance work triggered as conversation messages accumulate. Series show how many jobs are pending, in progress, or completed.

panels.title: $workspace representation queue items by state
panels.description: Extraction work that turns conversation content into structured observations. Series show how many jobs are pending, in progress, or completed.

panels.title: $workspace dream queue items by state
panels.description: Background reflection work that derives higher-level memory, such as deductions, patterns, contradictions, or card refreshes. Series show how many jobs are pending, in progress, or completed.

panels.title: $workspace deletion queue items by state
panels.description: Cleanup work that removes a session, observation, or workspace as requested. Series show how many jobs are pending, in progress, or completed.

panels.title: $workspace reconciler queue items by state
panels.description: Periodic self-healing work, including vector synchronization and queue cleanup. Series show how many jobs are pending, in progress, or completed.
